name: Tama Forest Science Garden

en.name: Tama Forest Science Garden
en.description: A pristine botanical research forest featuring over 1,500 cherry trees representing 250 species across Japan. Its quiet woodland trails offer rare botanical views and birdwatching throughout the seasons.
en.notes: Best visited during clear weather for relaxing walking tours and seasonal foliage photos.
en.reservation: Open access; no entrance reservation required.
en.parking: Park parking lot available on site.
